headline: PH vehicle sales inched up 3% in Oct; electrified vehicles provide boost
summary: Total vehicle unit sales in the Philippines climbed 3% in October from the previous month to 36,938 units. The Chamber of Automotive Manufacturers and the Truck Manufacturers Association said electrified vehicles supported the gain despite weak consumer demand.
why: Vehicle sales are a useful gauge of consumer spending and demand for auto manufacturers and dealers in emerging Asian markets.
